scope: Conditional first-order native-history forward applications of converged common-early optical means, original full native ERR unchanged. No refit, physical validation, or independent held-group prediction.
photon_partition_assumption: Positive point+coherent sky assigned to photon arrival rate; detector plane remains an additive electronic rate offset. This partition is not identified by broad-band rates.
